p1: King Saul had stopped following the Lord. Now he often felt troubled and unhappy inside.
His helpers said, “Let us find someone who plays the harp well.” When the king felt unhappy, soft music could help him feel well.
One helper said, “Jesse’s son David plays well, and the Lord is with him.” So Saul sent for David.
p2: Saul loved David very much. When Saul felt troubled, David plucked the strings of his harp. Then Saul felt refreshed and well, like new again.
David played to help someone else feel better. Soft music can help hearts feel calm. Tonight, hum a gentle song for someone you love.
old: After Saul disobeyed, an evil spirit troubled him. He felt sad and angry all the time. His servants said, “Let’s find someone to play music for you. Music might help!”
Someone said, “Jesse’s son David plays the harp beautifully. He’s brave, speaks well, and the Lord is with him.” So they sent for David.
Whenever the evil spirit troubled Saul, David would play his harp. The beautiful music calmed Saul down and made him feel better. The evil spirit would leave!
David used his talent to help someone who was hurting. Music from a pure heart has special power! When we use our gifts to help others, we’re serving Heavenly Father.
